transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you in today?

Well... I suppose I'm just having some trouble with... these doubts. I keep thinking I've missed something important. Um... like a number on a mortgage payment, or a mistake in a client proof at work. Or even just... a door not being latched. 

And... even when I know I checked it, the thought just sort of forces its way back. Just this feeling of... what if this is the mistake that costs you everything. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
When you have these doubts, do you find yourself doing something over and over—like checking locks, numbers, or other things—to make sure everything is okay?

Yes... I suppose so. I just... I end up reopening my design files a lot. Or rereading emails. With the payments, I'll check the online confirmation page over and over. And... sometimes I just have to repeat the figures silently in my head. Just until they feel... settled, I guess. 

It's... well, it turns a simple invoice or just a basic logo revision into... it takes hours. Hours I can't even bill for. So... yes, I do check things.
